top_signals.title: US Stocks Rise as Inflation Keeps Fed ‘At Bay,’ Spurs Tech Rally
top_signals.summary: US stocks traded higher after a subdued inflation reading helped ease pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, clearing the way for an earnings-led tech rally to continue.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: S&P 500 Earnings Are So Good Investors Are Starting to Worry
top_signals.summary: The latest reason to worry about the stock market is quite the doozy: Earnings growth has been too strong.
